title: Protection of fire separations from potential damage
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A wood-framed, four-storey sprinklered apartment building is over a non-combustible storage garage. A 2-hour concrete slab separates the garage; an elevator serves both areas. The garage elevator shaft has rated concrete walls on three sides and a proposed non-loadbearing steel-stud/rock-wool/two-layer Type X gypsum-board wall on the fourth side.
The local authority said the proposed gypsum assembly lacked testing for physical protection against damage; the appellant said its two-hour fire-resistance rating was sufficient.
The requirements discussed are Sentences 3.2.1.2.(1) and 3.1.10.2.(4) of Division B.
